title: Private Peggys Cove Express Tour from Halifax
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a fast, scenic private escape from Halifax to Nova Scotia’s most iconic coastal destination on this express tour designed for travelers short on time but big on experience.

Travel along the coast to the world-famous Peggy's Cove, where you’ll explore the rugged granite shoreline, iconic lighthouse, and charming fishing village. Enjoy sweeping Atlantic Ocean views, photo opportunities, and free time to walk the rocks and take in the scenery.

Continue to Ryer Retail for a unique coastal stop showcasing Nova Scotia’s lobster industry and local fishing traditions in an authentic setting.

This private experience is efficient, flexible, and ideal for cruise passengers or short stays. End your tour with an optional drop-off at the Halifax Waterfront Boardwalk, just a short walk from the cruise terminal, perfect for further exploring or an easy return to your ship.
